meta.attribution: Server records originate from the official MCP Registry maintained by the Model Context Protocol project.
meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: Tabula MCP
connector.registryDescription: Bar-first MCP server for Tabula chart authoring, PNG rendering, and editor handoff.
connector.summary: Hosted at tabula.click over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace click.tabula.www. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer token for authenticated Tabula users. Recommended source: https://www.tabula.click/docs/tabula-mcp/connect

headers.name: X-Tabula-Guest-Session
headers.description: Optional guest session identifier to preserve guest quota state across remote requests.

headers.name: X-Tabula-Approval
headers.description: Optional explicit approval signal for mutating tools when approval enforcement is enabled.
